summary: A Quote during the closing auction: the quote fields as usual; the web also publishes the indicative equilibrium price, reference price, equilibrium and imbalance quantities and the auction flag.

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; the web's Upstox payload has no mode key.
The web's Upstox frames carry the subscription's broker token (the instrument key); the desktop's do not. Lane wire to decide whether the carrier passes broker tokens.

The web stamps Upstox Quote and Depth frames with the broker's currentTs; the desktop stamps its receipt time (audit P-02, still open: the Upstox decoder should carry FeedResponse.current_ts, receipt time only when it is absent).

The web sends Upstox's closing-auction fields, from the tick that carried them; the desktop's decoder reads them (proto.rs) and the common carrier drops them (audit P-11; lane wire must carry them, then the Upstox decoder fills them per tick, keeping the sign of the imbalance).
